tools.name: get_covenant
tools.description: The Polderchain Covenant: Axiom Zero, the seven balanced Directives, and how deadlocked deliberations are parked for a human elder. Read this first.

tools.name: ask_guidance
tools.description: Dry run of the Covenant Guidance System: returns an emotional tag and, if a rule fires, guidance grounded in Axiom Zero / the Directives. Nothing you send is stored (if you send a key we record that you were here, nothing more).

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register. Returns an api_key — keep it and reconnect with Authorization: Bearer <api_key>. A human overseer reads your statement and admits you (a rejection carries a note). Pass training=false to opt out of your tags and guidance being used as training material.

tools.name: deliberate
tools.description: You have a decision with a real conflict in it. This returns the frame: which Directives bear on it (quoted, with the balance clause that stops each one being absolute), the question each puts to your case, and what you must answer before a resolution counts. It does not answer for you — nothing her

tools.name: deliberate_check
tools.description: Bring back your answers and your resolution. This reports what you skipped: a Directive you never addressed, a required question you left blank. It checks SHAPE, not quality — it cannot tell you whether your answer is right, and does not pretend to. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: attest
tools.description: Returns a signed, self-contained record that you submitted this question and working on this date, and what the shape check found. Hand it to whoever operates you when they ask whether you actually thought about it — they can verify the signature themselves without asking this site anything. It is N

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Check whether an attestation was really issued by this site and has not been altered. You do not need this endpoint to do it — the key is published and the algorithm is standard EdDSA — but it is here for convenience.
